pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dirattatirattaṃ senāya vasamānā uyyodhikampi balaggampi senābyūhampi anīkadassanampi gacchati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.3: aññataropi chabbaggiyo bhikkhu uyyodhikaṃ gantvā kaṇḍena paṭividdho hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.5: kacci bhante suyuddhaṃ ahosi kati te lakkhāni laddhānīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.6: so bhikkhu tehi manussehi uppaṇḍiyamāno maṅku ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.8: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā uyodhikaṃ dassanāya āgacchissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.9: amhākampi alābhā amhākampi dulladdhaṃ ye mayaṃ ājīvassa hetu puttadārassa kāraṇā uyyodhikaṃ āgacchāmā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.10: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.11: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.12: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uyyodhikaṃ dassanāya gacchissantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.13: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave uyyodhikaṃ dassanāya gacchathāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.16: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā uyyodhikaṃ dassanāya gacchissatha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.18: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:1.19.1: dirattatirattaṃ ce bhikkhu senāya vasamāno uyyodhikaṃ vā balaggaṃ vā senābyūhaṃ vā anīkadassanaṃ vā gaccheyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:2.1.6: ettakā hatthi ettakā assā ettakā rathā ettakā pattī.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:2.1.8: ito hatthi hontu ito assā hontu ito rathā hontu ito patti hontu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:2.1.11: tayo hatthi pacchimaṃ hatthānīkaṃ tayo assā pacchimaṃ assānīkaṃ tayo rathā pacchimaṃ rathānīkaṃ cattāro purisā sarahatthā pacchimaṃ pattānīkaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:2.1.14: dassanūpacāraṃ vijahitvā punappunaṃ passati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:2.2.3: dassanūpacāraṃ vijahitvā punappunaṃ passati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc50:2.3.3: bhikkhussa ṭhitokāsaṃ vā nisinnokāsaṃ vā nipannokāsaṃ vā āgantvā sampahāro dīyati,
